skill.name: twitter-automation
skill.description: Automates Twitter/X actions through the inference.sh CLI, including posts, media posts, likes, retweets, direct messages, follows, and lookups.
skill.summary: Run Twitter/X publishing and engagement actions with inference.sh app commands.
skill.author: inference-sh-9

security_audit.summary: Several static backtick findings are Markdown-only false positives, but multiple fenced examples do invoke external commands for Twitter/X account actions. The quick start contains a confirmed critical curl-to-shell installer pattern. Semantic review also found social engagement abuse risk because DMs, follows, likes, and retweets lack consent, rate-limit, or approval guidance.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the curl pipe with manual download steps, checksum verification, and a separate login command.
Require explicit user approval before posting, deleting, sending DMs, following, liking, or retweeting.

remediation.issue: Social engagement automation can enable abuse
remediation.suggestion: Document consent, rate-limit, anti-spam, and platform-policy requirements for DMs, follows, likes, and retweets.

remediation.issue: Related skill installation commands use npx
remediation.suggestion: Move related installs to non-executable references or require manual review before running package commands.

content.value_statement: Managing Twitter/X actions from an AI assistant can be slow and error-prone. This skill provides inference.sh commands for approved posts, media posts, engagement, DMs, follows, and lookups.
actual_capabilities: Runs inference.sh app commands for Twitter/X posts, likes, retweets, direct messages, follows, and lookups.
Creates text posts and media posts through listed X app IDs.
Provides examples for deleting posts and retrieving post details by ID.
Shows workflows that generate image or video assets before posting.
Links to inference.sh documentation for X integration setup.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI, login, and a configured X integration before actions can run.
The quick start installer uses a remote shell script that must be reviewed before use.
It does not include built-in rate-limit, consent, or approval controls for engagement actions.
It cannot guarantee posts, DMs, or follows comply with X platform rules.

use_cases.title: Publish Approved Updates
use_cases.description: Prepare controlled product updates and publish approved text or media posts from an AI assistant.

use_cases.title: Test X Integrations
use_cases.description: Validate an inference.sh X integration by posting, reading, and deleting controlled test tweets.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Creator Posts
use_cases.description: Draft media posts and run selected account actions after manual review and approval.

prompt_templates.title: Post a Simple Update
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the twitter-automation skill to publish this approved update to X: [text]. Confirm the account before posting.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Media Post
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an X post with this approved text and media URL: [text] and [media URL]. Ask before running the command.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Post Action
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the skill to retrieve post [post ID], summarize its details, and ask before deleting, liking, or retweeting it.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Controlled Campaign
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a three-post workflow using approved text, media URLs, and confirmation checkpoints. Run only the approved X actions.

output_examples.input: Post this approved product announcement to X.
output: Confirms the target account and post text.
Publishes the update through the text post app.
Reports the resulting post ID or link when available.

output_examples.input: Send a thank-you DM to this confirmed recipient.
output_examples.output: The assistant asks for recipient confirmation, sends the message through the DM app, and reports delivery status.

output_examples.input: Create an image post from this approved media URL.
output_examples.output: The assistant submits the media post, then records the final post details for review.

best_practices: Review every post, DM, follow, like, retweet, and delete action before execution.
Use test accounts or draft text when validating integration setup.
Install the inference.sh CLI through a reviewed, checksum-verified method.
anti_patterns: Do not pipe remote install scripts to a shell without inspection.
Do not run bulk likes, follows, retweets, or DMs without consent and rate limits.
Do not post generated media without checking rights, accuracy, and account context.

faq.question: Does this skill post directly to X?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses inference.sh X app commands to create text posts and media posts after setup.

faq.question: What setup is required?
faq.answer: You need the inference.sh CLI, an active login, and a configured X integration.

faq.question: Can it send DMs or follow users?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill lists direct message and follow actions, which should always require explicit approval.

faq.question: Does it include safety controls?
faq.answer: No built-in consent, rate-limit, or approval system is documented in the skill file.

faq.question: Why is the installer risky?
faq.answer: The quick start pipes a remote script to a shell. Review the script and verify checksums before installation.

faq.question: Can it schedule tweets?
faq.answer: The description mentions scheduling, but no dedicated scheduling command is shown in SKILL.md.
